data.name: DEAD RIG
data.detailed_description:
ABOUT THIS GAME

Death is not the end; it is simply part of the cycle aboard the station RESURRECTION_426. You are trapped in a recurring nightmare on a derelict ship drifting in deep space, overrun by grotesque horrors—the result of an automated cloning system that has been blindly re-printing degraded copies of what used to be human for centuries. Your survival is broken down into intense, short extraction scenarios across interconnected levels. Manage your dwindling resources and carve a path to the escape route. And if you die - no big deal: you wake up and try again. Reprinted. Repurposed.

KEY FEATURES

  • Scenario-Driven Survival: Experience the tension of survival horror with the pacing of a tactical shooter. Fight through short, standalone, multi-level campaigns where the only goal is to survive and escape.

  • Strategic Dismemberment: Headshots won't save you here - these monsters can still tear you apart even without their heads. Luckily, your M.O.D. tool (Multi Operations Device) can be tweaked in highly creative ways to help you tear your enemies apart limb by limb.

  • Resource Management: Every bullet, health pack, and resource counts. Explore the corridors of RESURRECTION_426, make difficult decisions about what to carry and what to recycle, and make every shot matter.

  • Over-the-Shoulder Terror: A claustrophobic, third-person perspective grounds you in the horror. Dynamic lighting, a suffocating atmosphere, and unpredictable enemy encounters ensure you are never truly safe.

  • Every Run is Different: You can't rely on memory to survive - enemy spawns, resource drops, and even the pathways through the ship are controlled by a dynamic choreographer that adjusts to your pacing, making every scenario brutal and unique—including randomized events that ensure you never get a moment's rest.

data.short_description: Dismember relentless biological horrors, scavenge for resources, and fight your way through intense, short campaigns with randomized elements in this brutal sci-fi survival horror where your only goal is to survive... and escape the station RESURRECTION_426.
